dialogues.jp: 「さて、今日は何を食うか……」
dialogues.en: "Now, what should I eat today..."
dialogues.text: "Now, what should I eat today..."

dialogues.jp:
昼休憩になり、学食でも行って来るかと、廊下
を歩いていると、環の姿が見えた。
dialogues.en:
It was lunch break. Walking down corridors to get to the
cafeteria, I saw Tamaki.
dialogues.text:
It was lunch break. Walking down corridors to get to the
cafeteria, I saw Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 環の背中に声を掛ける。
dialogues.en: I called out to her from behind.
dialogues.text: I called out to her from behind.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、環」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やあ、環も買い物か？」
dialogues.en: "You're buying lunch today?"
dialogues.text: "You're buying lunch today?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。今日はお弁当を忘れてしまって……」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I forgot to bring my lunch today..."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I forgot to bring my lunch today..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Hrm."
dialogues.text: "Hrm."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様は？」
dialogues.en: "What about you?"
dialogues.text: "What about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、学食にでも行こうかと思って」
dialogues.en: "I thought I'd go to the cafeteria for lunch today."
dialogues.text: "I thought I'd go to the cafeteria for lunch today."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、一緒に学食へ行かないか？　たまに
　は一緒にメシを食うのも悪くない」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, why don't we go together? It'd be fun to eat
together."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, why don't we go together? It'd be fun to eat
together."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you certain?"
dialogues.text: "Are you certain?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「二人で食った方がご飯もうまいし」
dialogues.en:
"The food tastes better when you're eating wtih someone
else."
dialogues.text:
"The food tastes better when you're eating wtih someone
else."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、じゃあ付いて行きます」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes. I will follow you."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes. I will follow you."

dialogues.jp:
環は俺の横には並ばずに、本当に後ろから『付
いてきて』いる。
dialogues.en:
Rather than walking beside me, she was literally following
me from behind.
dialogues.text:
Rather than walking beside me, she was literally following
me from behind.

dialogues.jp:
『男の人の半歩下がって後ろで歩く』を実践し
ているのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Is she trying to put that "every successful man has a good
woman behind him" phrase into practice?
dialogues.text:
Is she trying to put that "every successful man has a good
woman behind him" phrase into practice?

dialogues.jp:
それとも、俺と環の関係が｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝だからというの
を意識しているのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
And perhaps, unconsciously thinking about her place as my
supposed fiancee?
dialogues.text:
And perhaps, unconsciously thinking about her place as my
supposed fiancee?

dialogues.jp: もしそうだとしたら、とても古風だ……。
dialogues.en: If that's so, it's a really old custom....
dialogues.text: If that's so, it's a really old custom....

dialogues.jp: さすが大和撫子。
dialogues.en: A traditional Japanese lady, indeed.
dialogues.text: A traditional Japanese lady, indeed.

dialogues.jp: 食堂で弓を放った人物と同一とは思えない。
dialogues.en:
It's hard to believe that this is the same girl who fired an
arrow right through the cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
It's hard to believe that this is the same girl who fired an
arrow right through the cafeteria.

dialogues.jp: そんなことを考える。
dialogues.en: Then I remembered.
dialogues.text: Then I remembered.

dialogues.jp:
前に俺、後ろに環の一列の状態を保ったまま、
食堂にたどり着く。
dialogues.en:
Before, I had done the same thing, following her to the
cafeteria from behind.
dialogues.text:
Before, I had done the same thing, following her to the
cafeteria from behind.

dialogues.jp: ちなみに、環が後ろに下がっていた理由は、
dialogues.en:
THe reason I did so, is probably the same as the reason she
does so now.
dialogues.text:
THe reason I did so, is probably the same as the reason she
does so now.

dialogues.jp:
『廊下が狭いから』だったからだと、他の学生
とすれ違う時にやっと気づいた。
dialogues.en: Because the corridor is too damn narrow.
dialogues.text: Because the corridor is too damn narrow.

dialogues.jp: 「さてと、何食うべ」
dialogues.en: "Hm, what to eat..."
dialogues.text: "Hm, what to eat..."

dialogues.jp: 食券のボタンを見つめながら、環と二人で悩む。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the meal ticket buttons, the two of us pondered
on our meal.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the meal ticket buttons, the two of us pondered
on our meal.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「何か、オススメのメニューはありますか？」
dialogues.en: "Is there anything that's recommended on the menu?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anything that's recommended on the menu?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「オススメねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Recommended, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Recommended, huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ないことはないが、しょせん学食のメニュー
　だからな、それほど期待しない方がいいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Not really... this is a school cafeteria menu, don't get
your hopes up."
dialogues.text:
"Not really... this is a school cafeteria menu, don't get
your hopes up."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか。でも、朝倉様のオススメならきっ
　と大丈夫でしょう」
dialogues.en:
"I see. If it is recommended by you though, it should be
fine."
dialogues.text:
"I see. If it is recommended by you though, it should be
fine."

dialogues.jp: 俺はお金を入れ、中華丼のボタンを押す。
dialogues.en: I put some money inside, and pressed the chuukadon button.
dialogues.text: I put some money inside, and pressed the chuukadon button.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「それは何ですか？」
dialogues.en: "What would that be?"
dialogues.text: "What would that be?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、中華丼。うずらたまごがキュートなメ
　ニューだ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, it's chuukadon. It's quail and egg mixed up in a cute
box."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, it's chuukadon. It's quail and egg mixed up in a cute
box."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「中華丼……ああ、小さい頃に食べた記憶があ
　ります」
dialogues.en: "Chuukadon... ah yes, I remember tasting it as a child."
dialogues.text: "Chuukadon... ah yes, I remember tasting it as a child."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「でも、もうここ何年か口にしてません」
dialogues.en: "But I have not eaten it for several years."
dialogues.text: "But I have not eaten it for several years."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「環ってば、変わってるな……。普段何を食べ
　てるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"You're a different one, heh... what do you normally eat,
then?"
dialogues.text:
"You're a different one, heh... what do you normally eat,
then?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あ、あの｛しんせん／神饌｝って言って、大体は普通の食事
　と同じなんですけど」
dialogues.en:
"W, well, the food and alcohol served as offering for the
Gods, isn't that different from normal."
dialogues.text:
"W, well, the food and alcohol served as offering for the
Gods, isn't that different from normal."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「神様に供えたものの残りです」
dialogues.en: "The leftovers from the Gods, I mean."
dialogues.text: "The leftovers from the Gods, I mean."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Hrm."
dialogues.text: "Hrm."

dialogues.jp: 神が大食いだと、飯抜きなのだろうか？
dialogues.en: God must be quite the picky eater, if he leaves leftovers?
dialogues.text: God must be quite the picky eater, if he leaves leftovers?

dialogues.jp: ……異文化コミュニケーションだな。
dialogues.en: ...Probably just a misunderstanding in communications.
dialogues.text: ...Probably just a misunderstanding in communications.

dialogues.jp:
「で、何にするんだ？　早く決めないと、休み
　時間終わっちまうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, what are you eating? Better decide before lunch
break ends."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, what are you eating? Better decide before lunch
break ends."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、これを……」
dialogues.en: "I'd take this, then..."
dialogues.text: "I'd take this, then..."

dialogues.jp: 環が選んだのは、山菜うどんだった。
dialogues.en: She ended up choosing sansai noodles.
dialogues.text: She ended up choosing sansai noodles.

dialogues.jp: 中央のテーブルに席を取り、トレーを置く。
dialogues.en:
We chose a table at the center of the cafeteria, putting our
trays on it.
dialogues.text:
We chose a table at the center of the cafeteria, putting our
trays on it.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for the meal."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for the meal."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for the meal."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for the meal."

dialogues.jp: 環は箸を割る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki split her chopsticks with finesse.
dialogues.text: Tamaki split her chopsticks with finesse.

dialogues.jp: 俺はれんげで中華丼を口に含む。
dialogues.en: Meanwhile, I brought a spoonful of my chuukadon to my mouth.
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, I brought a spoonful of my chuukadon to my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「ねえねえ、あの人って……」
dialogues.en: "Hey hey, isn't that..."
dialogues.text: "Hey hey, isn't that..."

dialogues.jp: 俺はふと、後ろの女の子の声を耳にする。
dialogues.en: My ears caught wind of a girl's voice behind me.
dialogues.text: My ears caught wind of a girl's voice behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、あれ例の……」
dialogues.en: "Wasn't she the one who..."
dialogues.text: "Wasn't she the one who..."

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 2
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、あの人の近くに行くと変なことが起こ
　るっていう……」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, don't get too close to her, something weird might
happen..."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, don't get too close to her, something weird might
happen..."

dialogues.jp:
気がつくと、俺と環は何人かの学生の視線を受
けていた。
dialogues.en:
I then realized that it wasn't just them, but several pairs
of eyes that were watching us.
dialogues.text:
I then realized that it wasn't just them, but several pairs
of eyes that were watching us.

dialogues.jp: 正確に言うと、俺ではなく環が、だ。
dialogues.en: Or more accurately, watching Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Or more accurately, watching Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「怖いよな……また何か起こるのかな」
dialogues.en: "It's scary... who knows what'd happen with her."
dialogues.text: "It's scary... who knows what'd happen with her."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 2
dialogues.jp: 「あまり、近寄らないほうがいいぞ」
dialogues.en: "Better not to take risks."
dialogues.text: "Better not to take risks."

dialogues.jp: 学生たちは、環を見て｛おび／怯｝えたように噂している。
dialogues.en:
The students were watching her in fear, as they gossiped
amongst themselves.
dialogues.text:
The students were watching her in fear, as they gossiped
amongst themselves.

dialogues.jp:
目の前で丼が割れれば、まあ、無理もないと言
えなくもないが……。
dialogues.en:
Well, having seen a bowl split into half by her, it isn't
too unreasonable for them to be frightened...
dialogues.text:
Well, having seen a bowl split into half by her, it isn't
too unreasonable for them to be frightened...

dialogues.jp: 環を見ると、箸を止め、俯いている。
dialogues.en:
I turned my gaze back to Tamaki. Her chopsticks had stopped
moving, and her head was bowed.
dialogues.text:
I turned my gaze back to Tamaki. Her chopsticks had stopped
moving, and her head was bowed.

dialogues.jp: こういう時は、どうするべきなんだ？
dialogues.en: What can I do in this sort of situation?
dialogues.text: What can I do in this sort of situation?

dialogues.jp: 「場所、変えようか？」
dialogues.en: "Shall we move?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we move?"

dialogues.jp: 食堂に誘ったのは、実はまずかったのだろうか？
dialogues.en: I was the one who suggested coming here, after all...
dialogues.text: I was the one who suggested coming here, after all...

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、遅かれ早かれ、学園に居る限りいつ
か一度はこの場に来ることになるのだろうが。
dialogues.en:
Of course, this isn't the first time she's set foot in the
cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
Of course, this isn't the first time she's set foot in the
cafeteria.

dialogues.jp: でも、中傷を受けてまで居るべき場所ではない。
dialogues.en: But having to endure all this talking about her...
dialogues.text: But having to endure all this talking about her...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、いいんです」
dialogues.en: "No, it's fine."
dialogues.text: "No, it's fine."

dialogues.jp: 環は、にっこりと俺に微笑む。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki looked up to me, giving me as wide a smile as she
could muster.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki looked up to me, giving me as wide a smile as she
could muster.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「慣れてますから、平気です。わたくしにとっ
　ては、朝倉様とご飯が食べられる方が数倍嬉
　しいです」
dialogues.en:
"I am used to it. The chance to eat with you far outweighs
everything else."
dialogues.text:
"I am used to it. The chance to eat with you far outweighs
everything else."

dialogues.jp: 俺と？
dialogues.en: With me?
dialogues.text: With me?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「だって、許嫁なのに、こうして食事をするの
　も初めてなんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"After all, it's the first time I've eaten with my
fiancee..."
dialogues.text:
"After all, it's the first time I've eaten with my
fiancee..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「許嫁、ねぇ……」
dialogues.en: "Fiancee, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Fiancee, huh..."

dialogues.jp: そんなこと、言われるまで忘れていた。
dialogues.en: I'd forgotten about that.
dialogues.text: I'd forgotten about that.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、許嫁にされていること自体を忘れて
いる訳ではないけれど、日常生活で、それを意
識することはない。
dialogues.en:
Of course, not the fact itself, but more of it's existence
due to the everyday troubles of life.
dialogues.text:
Of course, not the fact itself, but more of it's existence
due to the everyday troubles of life.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、それもこれも理由がハッキリしないこと
と、だからといって何かを強制させられてる訳
ではないことが原因だろう。
dialogues.en:
The reason for it isn't clear now anyway, so there's no
point in forcing it.
dialogues.text:
The reason for it isn't clear now anyway, so there's no
point in forcing it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「それより、朝倉様の方こそ、不快な思いをし
　なかったか心配です」
dialogues.en:
"I am more concerned with your own discomfort at the
situation."
dialogues.text:
"I am more concerned with your own discomfort at the
situation."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「せっかくのお昼休みなのに、嫌な思いをさせ
　てしまって……」
dialogues.en: "It's lunch break after all, having to deal with this..."
dialogues.text: "It's lunch break after all, having to deal with this..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だよ。俺は気にしてないから……」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine. Don't worry about me..."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine. Don't worry about me..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった……」
dialogues.en: "That's a relief..."
dialogues.text: "That's a relief..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様に、そう言ってもらえて……」
dialogues.en: "To hear that from you, is..."
dialogues.text: "To hear that from you, is..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp:
どういう理由があったのかわからないけれど、
きっと何かあったんだろう。
dialogues.en:
I may not know why, what or how, but something definitely
happened.
dialogues.text:
I may not know why, what or how, but something definitely
happened.

dialogues.jp:
変な冗談で、校内で弓矢をぶっ放すなんてあり
得ないし。
dialogues.en:
Something more than just that bow and arrow stunt in the
cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
Something more than just that bow and arrow stunt in the
cafeteria.

dialogues.jp:
ま、環に関しては、わからないことだらけだけ
れど、今はただ待つことにしよう。
dialogues.en:
I'd just have to wait for a time where I can fully
understand everything.
dialogues.text:
I'd just have to wait for a time where I can fully
understand everything.

dialogues.jp:
なにせ、俺と環の間には『深い絆』があるのだ
から……。
dialogues.en: This, and the "deep bond" that we have...
dialogues.text: This, and the "deep bond" that we have...

dialogues.jp: ◆食堂での噂◆
dialogues.en: ◆Cafeteria Rumours?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Cafeteria Rumours?◆

dialogues.jp:
弁当を忘れたという環を連れ、昼休み食堂へ行っ
た。
dialogues.en:
The lunch-less Tamaki accompanied me to the cafeteria during
lunch break.
dialogues.text:
The lunch-less Tamaki accompanied me to the cafeteria during
lunch break.

dialogues.jp: 食堂では、学生たちが環のことを噂している。
dialogues.en:
At the location itself, Tamaki was subject to cruel gossping
from the students around us.
dialogues.text:
At the location itself, Tamaki was subject to cruel gossping
from the students around us.

dialogues.jp:
そりゃあ、食堂で、弓矢をぶっぱなして、丼を
まっぷたつにすりゃ、誰もが怖がるよな。
dialogues.en:
Of course, having seen her split a bowl into two with her
bow and arrows, who wouldn't be frightened.
dialogues.text:
Of course, having seen her split a bowl into two with her
bow and arrows, who wouldn't be frightened.

dialogues.jp: 環は『慣れているから平気』と笑って言った。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki eventually laughed it off, saying that she was used
to it.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki eventually laughed it off, saying that she was used
to it.
